title: Bat, Ball and the Price
summary: Test your first answer against every clue.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A bat and a ball cost 110 rupees together.
The bat costs 100 rupees more than the ball.
How much does the ball cost?
points: A bat and a ball cost 110 rupees together.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The quick answer is 10 rupees, but let us check that it works.
If the ball is 10, the bat would be 110, and together 120.
points: The quick answer is 10 rupees, but let us check that it works.

steps.title: The method: Check your first answer
sentences: Let the ball be x. Then the bat is x plus 100.
Together: x plus x plus 100 equals 110, so 2x equals 10.
points: Let the ball be x. Then the bat is x plus 100.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The ball costs 5 rupees and the bat costs 105 rupees.
Together that is 110, and the difference is 100.
The quick answer is often wrong, so always check it.
points: The ball costs 5 rupees and the bat costs 105 rupees.

quiz.q: Two items cost 50 together, and one costs 30 more than the other. The cheaper costs:
quiz.why: x plus x plus 30 is 50, so x is 10.
